buses.ru: Проверено на Hyundai Coupe 2003 2.0 АКПП: K-line ISO 14230 KWP fast (протокол 5). Отвечают двигатель (адрес 11, 16 PID, датчик MAP, без MAF) и АКПП (адрес 18, только 01 01, Mode 03 и Mode 09 CALID). VIN в ЭБУ хранится с «x» вместо части знаков (KMHH…D…3U…).
buses.en: Checked on a Hyundai Coupe 2003 2.0 automatic: K-line ISO 14230 KWP fast (protocol 5). The engine ECU (address 11, 16 PIDs, MAP sensor, no MAF) and the TCU (address 18: only 01 01, Mode 03 and Mode 09 CALID) answer. The ECU stores its VIN with 'x' in place of some characters (KMHH…D…3U…).

note.ru: Мотор 2.0 Beta II — по 8-му знаку VIN («D») и калибровке АКПП TGK0D20NF5. Tiburon в США, Tuscani в Корее, Coupe в Европе и России. Автомат — 4-ступенчатый F4A42 (INVECS II). Протокол у поздних лет не проверен: приложение перебирает все само.
note.en: 2.0 Beta II engine — by the 8th VIN character ('D') and the TCU calibration TGK0D20NF5. Tiburon in the US, Tuscani in Korea, Coupe in Europe and Russia. Automatic: 4-speed F4A42 (INVECS II). Protocol of later years not checked: the app tries all of them.

signals.note: ScanGauge 'Transmission Temperature Alternative': 07E1 21A0, RXF 0322 (2nd consecutive frame), RXD 2808 -> data byte 13 after 61 A0; MTH 9/5-40 degF = raw-40 degC. OBDb Elantra/Santa Fe/Sportage/Soul/Stinger: bix 104, -40. ScanGauge's main variant (RXF 0325, RXD 2008 -> data byte 33) is for other TCUs; not included.
ScanGauge 'Transmission Temperature Alternative 3': 07E0 21A0, RXF 0322, RXD 2808, same scaling. For cars where the gearbox is run by the engine ECU; ScanGauge does not name the models.

ScanGauge 'Engine Oil Temperature': 07E0 2101, RXF 0325 (5th consecutive frame), RXD 2808 -> data byte 34; MTH 27/20-54 degF = 0.75*raw-48 degC. OBDb Elantra/Santa Fe (to 2018)/Sonata (to 2019): bix 272, *0.75-48.

n-cars.net: 22E001 on 7E0 is CVVT oil temp, Torque token AI (= data byte 34); the Elantra CN7 fitted curve there is ~0.75*AI-48 (e.g. AI=160 -> 72 degC). OBDb Kona/Forte/Seltos/Sportage/Stinger: bix 272, /1.3333-48.

JejuSoul: 22b002 on 7c6, Int24(g:h:i) = data bytes 6..8. OVMS Niro EV: frame 1 CAN_UINT24(3) = the same bytes. OVMS reads Kona from bytes 9..11 instead (OBDb: that is the miles field) -- if the value looks wrong, the car may differ.
Raw BMS SOC; the SOC shown on the dash is in page 05.
SOC as shown on the dash.
Raw BMS SOC; the SOC shown on the dash is in page 05.
SOC as shown on the dash.
JejuSoul: 2102 on 7E2, token X (= data byte 23). OVMS Niro: VMCU $21 02 frame 3 CAN_BYTE(5) = the same byte.
